CommunityApplications.Profile:
Installs [micro](https://micro-editor.github.io/), a modern terminal text editor, so you can edit files straight from the Unraid web terminal or over SSH instead of copying them to another machine.
Unraid gives you `vi` and nothing friendlier — editing a User Script, a config file under `/boot`, or a compose file on a share usually means fighting `vi` or moving the file elsewhere. micro behaves the way you would expect: `Ctrl+S` saves, `Ctrl+Q` quits, `Ctrl+C` and `Ctrl+V` copy and paste, the mouse works, and syntax highlighting covers 130+ languages. It ships upstream as a single statically linked binary with no dependencies.
The plugin installs one specific micro release together with its SHA256, verifies the archive against micro's published checksum before installing anything, caches the verified archive on the flash drive so reinstalls work even if GitHub is unreachable, and keeps your settings, keybindings and Lua plugins on the flash drive so they survive a reboot. There is no daemon, and no network access after installation.
Maintained by zwinout. Bug reports and feature requests are welcome in the issue tracker.
